subject: Trust bundle & subprocessor roster request — Zenith Therapeutics
messages:
From: Alice Monroe <procurement@zenith-thera.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trust bundle & subprocessor roster request for procurement review

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the demo last week — Zenith is moving to a formal security review as part of our procurement gate. Our security and procurement teams have a few asks we need to close before we can advance the POC to a contract. Could you please provide the following by EOD Friday (6/13)?

1) Current subprocessor roster (machine readable preferred) with region/residency, KMS responsibility, and whether the subprocessor handles production inference traffic vs analytics.
2) SOC 2 Type II report (summary is fine for initial review) and date of last audit.
3) SIG-lite or CAIQ responses that map to the questions in the attached questionnaire (we'll accept a CSV).
4) Short statement confirming whether Redwood Private (on-prem / VPC) options can be configured so that customer-managed KMS is used and whether logs/audit proofs can be exported to a customer S3/Historic archive.

Also, because this will be used for regulated clinical workflows, we need to understand your controls around ephemeral key rotation and export-control residency for inference keys. A short KMS residency statement and any relevant attachments would be helpful.

We can sign an NDA if needed — I can loop Legal. Would it be possible to have a short call Thursday to walk through the roster?

Thanks,

Alice Monroe
Procurement Manager
Zenith Therapeutics
procurement@zenith-thera.com

Attachments referenced: Zenith_Security_Questionnaire_v1.docx (we attached this to the procurement portal)

- Neha (Security) will own the SIG-lite/CAIQ mapping and the KMS residency statement.
- Marissa (Solutions + Private deployments) will confirm the customer-managed KMS workflow and export capabilities for audit logs.

Questions for you:
- Do you need FIPS/HSM-level details for KMS (we can provide the HSM vendor and residency topology)?
- For the signed NDA, do you want our standard mutual NDA or a Zenith template? I can push DocuSign if you prefer.

Best,

Marcus — thanks, this looks good and the proposed timeline works for us. A couple quick clarifications before the call: 

- Can you include the specific contractual clause numbers that cover HelixCloud Integrations (we have to ensure subprocessor flowdowns exist)? If you can point to the DPA sections, that would speed Legal review.
- For the KMS residency statement: we need explicit confirmation that customer-managed KMS keys will never be exported from the defined residency region (i.e., keys created in EU remain in EU without cross-border export). If you can add that line to the statement, that would be ideal.
- We also want a short example of the audit log manifest (a 1-page example listing available fields and retention windows) so we can validate against our archival policy.

We'll review the SOC2 summary and roster once they land. Please go ahead and send the NDA link — Zenith prefers to sign digitally. Call confirmed: Thu 6/12 10:00 PT.

Best,

Alice Monroe

Zenith Therapeutics
